about.title: About Proud Muslim
about.description: Empowering Muslims worldwide with accurate prayer times, Quran study, authentic adhkar, and Islamic tools.
about.purposeText1: Proud Muslim is an all-in-one Islamic utility application designed to assist Muslims in their daily worship, Quranic recitation, prayer punctuality, and Islamic learning with a clean, respectful interface.
about.purposeText2: We prioritize privacy, accuracy, accessibility, and respect for Islamic traditions while leveraging modern mobile technology.
about.featuresIntro: Proud Muslim provides a rich suite of daily Islamic tools, including:
about.feature1: Accurate Prayer Times with worldwide calculation methods and customizable adhan notifications.
about.feature2: Qibla Direction finder using onboard device compass and GPS sensors.
about.feature3: Complete Holy Quran with multi-language translations, word-by-word highlights, and audio recitations.
about.feature4: 99 Names of Allah (Asma-ul-Husna) with audio pronunciations, meanings, and comprehensive explanations.
about.feature5: Hisnul Muslim Adhkar, Duas, and digital Tasbih counter for daily remembrance.
about.feature6: Islamic Hijri Calendar, Zakat Calculator, and Community Mosque locator tools.
about.freeForeverNotice: Commitment: The Holy Quran text, 99 Names of Allah, and fundamental prayer adhans will always remain 100% accessible to every user.
about.freeForeverText: We firmly believe that essential Islamic worship tools should be freely accessible. Core Quran reading, audio adhans for prayer calls, and Asma-ul-Husna study will never be locked behind mandatory paywalls.
about.developerText: Proud Muslim is developed, published, and maintained by ANM Digital Labs. We are dedicated to creating high-quality, privacy-respecting software and digital tools for the global Muslim community.
about.limitationsText: Proud Muslim is an informational and technological aid. It does not issue religious fatwas, replace qualified Islamic scholars, or substitute local mosque authorities. Users should always consult qualified scholars for important fiqh and religious rulings.

privacyTerms.title: Privacy Policy and Terms of Use
privacyTerms.description: Effective 2 September 2026. This combined document details our privacy practices and the terms governing your use of Proud Muslim.
privacyTerms.privacyNotice: Summary: Proud Muslim processes device permissions (such as location and notifications) locally to provide prayer times, Qibla direction, and reminders. We do not sell your personal data.
privacyTerms.whoWeAreText: Proud Muslim is provided by ANM Digital Labs (“we”, “us”, “our”). For privacy enquiries or data requests, contact us at info@anmdigital.online.
privacyTerms.locationText: With your explicit permission, the app processes precise or approximate GPS coordinates strictly on-device to calculate astronomical prayer times, identify your locality, and calculate Qibla direction. You may revoke location access at any time in device settings.
privacyTerms.deviceText: Platform services may process basic technical data such as operating system version, device model, app version, language, and crash diagnostics to ensure app stability and security.
privacyTerms.preferencesText: User preferences (calculation method, juristic method, selected reciter, theme, bookmark progress, and profile image) are stored locally on your device storage.
privacyTerms.purchasesText: In-app purchases and optional premium subscriptions are processed directly through Google Play Store or Apple App Store. We do not store or process your credit card numbers or banking information.
privacyTerms.communicationsText: When you email support, we retain your email address and message contents solely to resolve your support inquiry.
privacyTerms.permLocation: Location: Used strictly for calculating prayer times and Qibla compass bearing.
privacyTerms.permSensors: Compass & Motion Sensors: Used to dynamically orient the Qibla needle.
privacyTerms.permNotifications: Notifications & Exact Alarms: Used to trigger adhan prayer calls and scheduled reminders.
privacyTerms.permMedia: Photo/Media Picker: Used solely if you voluntarily pick a custom profile picture.
privacyTerms.permInternet: Internet: Used to download Quran audio, fetch translation packages, and open official links.
privacyTerms.permBilling: Billing: Managed by the Google Play / App Store platform for optional upgrades.
privacyTerms.legalBasesText: We process information based on contract performance (delivering requested app features), your explicit consent (for optional device permissions), legitimate interests in maintaining app security, and compliance with legal obligations.
privacyTerms.providersText: Platform infrastructure includes Google Play Services, Apple App Store, and operating-system notification channels. Each third party operates under its respective privacy terms.
privacyTerms.sharingText: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to data brokers or third-party advertisers.
privacyTerms.retentionText: Local settings persist on your device until you clear app data or uninstall the app. Support emails are retained only for as long as necessary to resolve inquiries.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer and Limitations
disclaimer.description: Crucial information regarding prayer times, Qibla compasses, translations, and religious advice.
disclaimer.centralNotice: Notice: Proud Muslim is an informational and technological worship tool. It does not replace qualified Islamic scholars, local religious authorities, or direct astronomical observation.
disclaimer.prayerTimesText: Prayer times are calculated using recognized astronomical algorithms (e.g., Diyanet, MWL, ISNA, Umm al-Qura). Variations may arise due to elevation, atmospheric refraction, micro-climates, and local mosque conventions. Always follow your local mosque adhan when available.
disclaimer.qiblaText: The digital Qibla compass depends on your mobile device’s internal magnetometer and GPS accuracy. Electromagnetic interference, metal cases, and uncalibrated sensors can cause directional deviations. Always calibrate your compass by moving your phone in a figure-8 motion.
disclaimer.hijriText: Hijri dates are based on calculated astronomical moon phases. Actual Islamic months and religious observances (Ramadan, Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha) depend on verified local moonsighting declarations by official regional religious authorities.
disclaimer.quranText: The authentic Quran is exclusively the Arabic text revealed to Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). All translations in English, Turkish, Urdu, German, etc., are human interpretations of the meanings and cannot encompass the full linguistic depth of the Arabic revelation.
disclaimer.zakatText: The Zakat tool provides general calculations based on user-entered values and standard nisab rates. Complex financial situations, business inventory, and specific debt obligations should be reviewed with a qualified Islamic financial scholar.
disclaimer.notificationsText: Device operating systems, battery optimization modes, Do Not Disturb settings, and OEM background task limits may delay or suppress adhan notifications. Users are advised not to rely exclusively on mobile notifications for time-critical obligations.
disclaimer.scholarsText: No content within Proud Muslim constitutes formal legal fatwas. For personal fiqh, family law, or religious disputes, consult accredited Islamic scholars and authoritative institutions in your community.

datasets.title: Datasets and Content Sources
datasets.description: Transparent documentation of all Quran texts, translations, prayer calculations, and audio sources.
datasets.introNotice: We believe in full transparency regarding data sources. Below is the complete catalog of digital datasets utilized in Proud Muslim.
datasets.quranTableDesc: Multi-language Quran text files, translators, licensors, and access modes:
datasets.prayerText: Supported calculation methodologies include Diyanet İşleri Başkanlığı (Turkey), Muslim World League (MWL), Islamic Society of North America (ISNA), Umm al-Qura University (Makkah), Egyptian General Authority of Survey, University of Islamic Sciences (Karachi), and Gulf Region conventions.
datasets.hadithText: Adhkar, morning/evening supplications, and daily duas are sourced from Hisnul Muslim (Fortress of the Muslim) by Saeed bin Ali bin Wahf Al-Qahtani, verified against authentic Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim narrations.
datasets.audioText: Proud Muslim currently streams Mishary Rashid Alafasy's Quran recitation (edition ar.alafasy) from the Al Quran Cloud audio CDN operated by Islamic Network. Copyright remains with the reciter or applicable rights holder.
datasets.verificationNotice: Verification Policy: We do not invent sources or licenses. All dataset information is cross-referenced with upstream maintainers. If any discrepancy is identified, it is promptly reviewed and corrected.
